newsitem.title: USA: CME hog calls mixed, pork bellies steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hog calls mixed, pork bellies steady to lower.

text.p: Early calls on CME hog futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb higher to 0.100 lower while pork belly futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 lower, livestock analysts said..
Mostly steady to instances firm cash hog indications for Monday's markets prompted ideas of carryover strength in hog futures. Hot weather has also cut weight gains, they said.

However, hog futures recently approached technical resistance and hog runs are expected to increase during the week as cooler weather moves into the Midwest which could turn futures lower, they added.

Recent talk of Japanese buying of cash pork has not been borne out by concrete evidence of increased pork movement. Loins, if anything, are the main cut being purchased by the Japanese, one analyst said.
Pork bellies were expected to show further weakness after dipping on Friday after Thursday's limit gains. Only steady cash product provided little direction, analysts said.
The July contract expires at 1200 CDT and this may keep trade activity light until that month goes off the board, they added.
